items.title: Volunteer with Norfolk Public Library
items.summary: Help at a library branch, with youth or adult programs, community outreach, communications, or special events. Opportunities and schedules vary by assignment.

participation.whatYouWillDo: Support library services, programs, outreach, or events.

items.title: Volunteer with Norfolk Parks & Recreation
items.summary: Support city recreation programs, projects, or special events. Opportunities range from one-day events to ongoing roles and placement follows the city's application process.

participation.whatYouWillDo: Assist with recreation programs, community projects, or special events.
participation.timeCommitment: One-day or ongoing; varies by role
